name: Whispers of the Luminaries
source: A rising star vanishes without a trace. When police investigators hit a dead end, you're dragged into a case that gets progressively darker as you uncover the truth. Follow leads, spot contradictions, and shape your relationships in this VN inspired by Danganronpa and Famicom Detective Club.
translation: 一颗冉冉升起的新星消失得无影无踪。警方的调查陷入僵局，你却被卷入此案，而随着真相逐渐揭开，案情也愈发黑暗。在这部受《弹丸论破》与《Famicom侦探俱乐部》启发的视觉小说中，追查线索、找出矛盾，并塑造你与他人的关系。
